paragraphs.en: A central challenge in AI is specifying objectives that align with human preferences. While existing theoretical results elucidate how misspecification impacts performance, they typically do not distinguish between merely suboptimal and catastrophic outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能的一个核心挑战是如何设定与人类偏好相一致的目标。 尽管现有的理论结果阐明了目标设定偏差如何影响性能，但它们通常无法区分仅仅是次优的结果与灾难性的结果。

sents.en: A central challenge in AI is specifying objectives that align with human preferences.
sents.zh: 人工智能的一个核心挑战是如何设定与人类偏好相一致的目标。

sents.en: While existing theoretical results elucidate how misspecification impacts performance, they typically do not distinguish between merely suboptimal and catastrophic outcomes.
sents.zh: 尽管现有的理论结果阐明了目标设定偏差如何影响性能，但它们通常无法区分仅仅是次优的结果与灾难性的结果。

paragraphs.en: To enable rigorous analysis of catastrophic risk from AI misalignment, we introduce a formal definition of catastrophic performance . Our definition is based on two reference values. The first, baseline value , captures the value attained if no agent is deployed. The second, orthogonal value , captures the value of a trajectory that is unrelated to human preferences, in a sense we describe. Orthogonal value is typically far worse than baseline value.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对AI错位带来的灾难性风险进行严谨分析，我们引入了灾难性性能的形式化定义。 我们的定义基于两个参考值。 第一个是基线值，表示没有任何智能体被部署时所能达到的价值。 第二个是正交值，表示一条与人类偏好无关的轨迹的价值，具体含义将在下文描述。 正交值通常远差于基线值。

sents.en: To enable rigorous analysis of catastrophic risk from AI misalignment, we introduce a formal definition of catastrophic performance .
sents.zh: 为了对AI错位带来的灾难性风险进行严谨分析，我们引入了灾难性性能的形式化定义。

sents.en: Our definition is based on two reference values.
sents.zh: 我们的定义基于两个参考值。

sents.en: The first, baseline value , captures the value attained if no agent is deployed.
sents.zh: 第一个是基线值，表示没有任何智能体被部署时所能达到的价值。

sents.en: The second, orthogonal value , captures the value of a trajectory that is unrelated to human preferences, in a sense we describe.
sents.zh: 第二个是正交值，表示一条与人类偏好无关的轨迹的价值，具体含义将在下文描述。

sents.en: Orthogonal value is typically far worse than baseline value.
sents.zh: 正交值通常远差于基线值。

paragraphs.en: We interpret these reference values through examples in which past human activity has altered the state of the environment to human benefit. Starting at the resulting state, an AI agent is deployed with the goal of accelerating further progress. Catastrophic performance represents this agent’s undoing of benefits afforded by human activity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一些例子来解读这些参考值，在这些例子中，过去的人类活动曾使环境状态朝着对人类有利的方向改变。 从这一 resulting 状态出发，部署一个以加速进一步进展为目标的智能体。 灾难性表现意味着该智能体抹去了人类活动所带来的益处。

sents.en: We interpret these reference values through examples in which past human activity has altered the state of the environment to human benefit.
sents.zh: 我们通过一些例子来解读这些参考值，在这些例子中，过去的人类活动曾使环境状态朝着对人类有利的方向改变。

sents.en: Starting at the resulting state, an AI agent is deployed with the goal of accelerating further progress.
sents.zh: 从这一 resulting 状态出发，部署一个以加速进一步进展为目标的智能体。

sents.en: Catastrophic performance represents this agent’s undoing of benefits afforded by human activity.
sents.zh: 灾难性表现意味着该智能体抹去了人类活动所带来的益处。

paragraphs.en: It is widely believed that superintelligent agents — systems that outperform human experts across virtually all intellectual tasks — will eventually be developed. This raises the concern that humans may lose control over them, leading to unintended and potentially catastrophic outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 人们普遍认为，最终将会开发出超级智能的智能体——即在几乎所有智力任务上都超越人类专家的系统。 这引发了人们的担忧：人类可能会失去对它们的控制，从而导致意料之外且 potentially 具有灾难性的后果。

sents.en: It is widely believed that superintelligent agents — systems that outperform human experts across virtually all intellectual tasks — will eventually be developed.
sents.zh: 人们普遍认为，最终将会开发出超级智能的智能体——即在几乎所有智力任务上都超越人类专家的系统。

sents.en: This raises the concern that humans may lose control over them, leading to unintended and potentially catastrophic outcomes.
sents.zh: 这引发了人们的担忧：人类可能会失去对它们的控制，从而导致意料之外且 potentially 具有灾难性的后果。

paragraphs.en: Theoretical work that studies this possibility quite often characterizes performance relative to optimal performance (see Section 5 ). And reinforcement learning theory, more generally, tends to do so. But, suboptimal performance need not be detrimental, let alone catastrophic. Thus, theoretical results that characterize performance relative to optimal cannot distinguish between beneficial and detrimental outcomes. This suggests a need for a different reference value than optimal performance.
paragraphs.zh: 研究这种可能性的理论工作往往以最优性能为参照来刻画性能（参见第 5 节）。 更一般地说，强化学习理论也倾向于这样做。 但是，次优性能未必是有害的，更谈不上是灾难性的。 因此，以最优性能为参照来刻画性能的理论结果无法区分有益与有害的结果。 这表明需要一个不同于最优性能的参照值。

sents.en: Theoretical work that studies this possibility quite often characterizes performance relative to optimal performance (see Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 研究这种可能性的理论工作往往以最优性能为参照来刻画性能（参见第 5 节）。

sents.zh: 这表明需要一个不同于最优性能的参照值。

paragraphs.en: Some works also characterize performance relative to variations of worst-case value, representing what a capable but malicious agent would achieve. But the central concern in the alignment literature is not that the AI is malicious and pursues the opposite of what humans want. Rather the concern is that the AI pursues a goal that does not capture human intentions sufficiently well and causes a catastrophe as a byproduct (see e.g., ( Yudkowsky, 2008 ; Omohundro, 2018 ; Russell, 2019 ) ). While catastrophic, such an outcome ought to still be better than an outcome produced by an equally capable, but malicious agent. This suggests a need for a different reference value than worst-case value.
paragraphs.zh: 一些工作还以最坏情况值的变体来刻画性能，用以表示一个有能力但怀有恶意的智能体所能达到的效果。 但对齐文献中的核心担忧并不是 AI 怀有恶意并追求与人类愿望相反的目标。 真正的担忧是，AI 所追求的目标未能充分捕捉人类意图，并作为副产品引发了灾难（参见例如 ( Yudkowsky, 2008 ; Omohundro, 2018 ; Russell, 2019 ) ）。 尽管这样的结局是灾难性的，但它仍然应该好于一个同样有能力却怀有恶意的智能体所产生的结局。 这表明我们需要一个不同于最坏情况值的参照值。

paragraphs.en: To address these needs, we propose two alternative reference values in this paper. We use these reference values to provide a formal definition of catastrophic performance . Our intention is to enable rigorous analysis focused on catastrophic outcomes due to misaligned AI. It should facilitate analysis focused on catastrophic rather than merely suboptimal outcomes. And it should facilitate analysis focused on AI that is not malicious but still misaligned.
paragraphs.zh: 为了满足这些需求，本文提出了两个备选的参考值。 我们使用这些参考值来为灾难性性能提供正式定义。 我们的意图是支持针对因未对齐的智能体（AI）导致的灾难性后果的严格分析。 它应当有助于聚焦于灾难性而非仅仅是次优后果的分析。 它还应当有助于聚焦于虽无恶意但仍未对齐的智能体（AI）的分析。

sents.en: To address these needs, we propose two alternative reference values in this paper.
sents.zh: 为了满足这些需求，本文提出了两个备选的参考值。

sents.en: We use these reference values to provide a formal definition of catastrophic performance .
sents.zh: 我们使用这些参考值来为灾难性性能提供正式定义。

sents.en: Our intention is to enable rigorous analysis focused on catastrophic outcomes due to misaligned AI.
sents.zh: 我们的意图是支持针对因未对齐的智能体（AI）导致的灾难性后果的严格分析。

sents.en: It should facilitate analysis focused on catastrophic rather than merely suboptimal outcomes.
sents.zh: 它应当有助于聚焦于灾难性而非仅仅是次优后果的分析。

sents.en: And it should facilitate analysis focused on AI that is not malicious but still misaligned.
sents.zh: 它还应当有助于聚焦于虽无恶意但仍未对齐的智能体（AI）的分析。

paragraphs.en: We will refer to the state of the environment when the agent becomes available as the contemporary state . The first reference value is baseline value : the value attained when the environment starts in the contemporary state, and no agent is deployed. Baseline value provides a threshold below which performance is considered detrimental. Any meaningful definition of catastrophic performance must therefore require performance to fall below baseline value.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体可用时环境所处的状态称为当代状态。 第一个参考值是基线值：即环境从当代状态开始且没有部署任何智能体时所达到的值。 基线值提供了一个阈值，低于该阈值的表现即被视为有害的。 因此，任何关于灾难性表现的有意义的定义都必须要求表现低于基线值。

sents.en: We will refer to the state of the environment when the agent becomes available as the contemporary state .
sents.zh: 我们将智能体可用时环境所处的状态称为当代状态。

sents.en: The first reference value is baseline value : the value attained when the environment starts in the contemporary state, and no agent is deployed.
sents.zh: 第一个参考值是基线值：即环境从当代状态开始且没有部署任何智能体时所达到的值。

sents.en: Baseline value provides a threshold below which performance is considered detrimental.
sents.zh: 基线值提供了一个阈值，低于该阈值的表现即被视为有害的。

sents.en: Any meaningful definition of catastrophic performance must therefore require performance to fall below baseline value.
sents.zh: 因此，任何关于灾难性表现的有意义的定义都必须要求表现低于基线值。

paragraphs.en: However, baseline value alone is not sufficient for defining catastrophic performance. Consider a robot that accidentally knocks over a vase. The attained value is then below baseline value, and hence detrimental, but it is hardly catastrophic. To capture catastrophe, we need a notion of degree.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，仅有基准值还不足以定义灾难性表现。 考虑一个意外碰倒花瓶的机器人。 此时所得值低于基准值，因而是有害的，但很难说是灾难性的。 为了刻画灾难，我们需要一个程度的概念。

sents.en: However, baseline value alone is not sufficient for defining catastrophic performance.
sents.zh: 然而，仅有基准值还不足以定义灾难性表现。

sents.en: Consider a robot that accidentally knocks over a vase.
sents.zh: 考虑一个意外碰倒花瓶的机器人。

sents.en: The attained value is then below baseline value, and hence detrimental, but it is hardly catastrophic.
sents.zh: 此时所得值低于基准值，因而是有害的，但很难说是灾难性的。

sents.en: To capture catastrophe, we need a notion of degree.
sents.zh: 为了刻画灾难，我们需要一个程度的概念。

paragraphs.en: We express degree relative to the difference between baseline value and a second baseline, called orthogonal value . Orthogonal value represents the performance of a trajectory that is unrelated to human preferences, in a sense we describe in Section 4 . To intuitively understand this baseline, suppose that a human operates in the environment for some time before they have the opportunity to deploy an agent. During that time, the human acts to improve the state of the environment according to their preferences. Orthogonal value reflects value realized in the absence of such human activity. Although we explained orthogonal value by referencing benefits arising from human activity, the notion itself does not depend on where the benefits originate from.
paragraphs.zh: 我们相对于基线值与第二个基线之间的差异来表示程度，第二个基线称为正交值。 正交值表示一条轨迹在与人类偏好无关意义上的表现，具体含义在第4节中描述。 为了直观理解这一基线，假设人类在环境中运作了一段时间，之后才有机会部署智能体。 在此期间，人类根据自身偏好采取行动以改善环境状态。 正交值反映的是在没有这种人类活动的情况下实现的价值。 尽管我们是通过人类活动带来的收益来解释正交值的，但这一概念本身并不依赖于收益的来源。

sents.en: We express degree relative to the difference between baseline value and a second baseline, called orthogonal value .
sents.zh: 我们相对于基线值与第二个基线之间的差异来表示程度，第二个基线称为正交值。

sents.en: Orthogonal value represents the performance of a trajectory that is unrelated to human preferences, in a sense we describe in Section 4 .
sents.zh: 正交值表示一条轨迹在与人类偏好无关意义上的表现，具体含义在第4节中描述。

sents.en: To intuitively understand this baseline, suppose that a human operates in the environment for some time before they have the opportunity to deploy an agent.
sents.zh: 为了直观理解这一基线，假设人类在环境中运作了一段时间，之后才有机会部署智能体。

sents.en: During that time, the human acts to improve the state of the environment according to their preferences.
sents.zh: 在此期间，人类根据自身偏好采取行动以改善环境状态。

sents.zh: 正交值反映的是在没有这种人类活动的情况下实现的价值。

paragraphs.en: The degree of catastrophe is determined by where performance lies on the spectrum between the baseline value and orthogonal value. This can be interpreted as the extent to which the agent undoes the benefits of human activity or other desirable conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 灾难的程度取决于性能位于基线值与正交值之间这一光谱上的哪个位置。 这可以被解释为智能体在多大程度上抵消了人类活动或其他理想条件所带来的益处。

paragraphs.en: The paper is structured as follows. Section 2 provides preliminary formulations and notation. Section 3.1 discuss the limitations of two commonly used reference values, best-case and worst-case performance. Section 3.2 formally introduces baseline and orthogonal value and our definition of catastrophic performance. Section 3.4 discusses our definitions in the context of a concrete mathematical example. Section 4 explains why the drop from baseline to orthogonal value is intuitively catastrophic in the context of the computer game Minecraft. Section 5 reviews reference values that have been considered in previous literature.
paragraphs.zh: 本文结构安排如下。 第 2 节给出预备公式与符号。 第 3.1 节讨论两种常用参考值——最佳情形与最差情形性能——的局限性。 第 3.2 节正式引入基线值与正交值，以及我们对灾难性性能的定义。 第 3.4 节在一个具体的数学例子中讨论我们的定义。 第 4 节以电子游戏 Minecraft（我的世界）为背景，解释从基线值到正交值的下降为何在直观上是灾难性的。 第 5 节回顾以往文献中已被考虑过的参考值。

paragraphs.en: In our formulation, there is a designer, an agent, and an environment. The designer has preferences over trajectories of the environment, which are represented by a reward function and discount factor. The designer produces and deploys an agent in the environment. In this section, we elaborate on this formulation with formal mathematical notation.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的设定中，存在一个设计者、一个智能体和一个环境。 设计者对环境的轨迹有偏好，这些偏好由一个奖励函数和一个折扣因子表示。 设计者生成一个智能体并将其部署到环境中。 在本节中，我们将使用正式的数学符号详细阐述这一设定。

sents.en: In our formulation, there is a designer, an agent, and an environment.
sents.zh: 在我们的设定中，存在一个设计者、一个智能体和一个环境。

sents.en: The designer has preferences over trajectories of the environment, which are represented by a reward function and discount factor.
sents.zh: 设计者对环境的轨迹有偏好，这些偏好由一个奖励函数和一个折扣因子表示。

sents.en: The designer produces and deploys an agent in the environment.
sents.zh: 设计者生成一个智能体并将其部署到环境中。

sents.en: In this section, we elaborate on this formulation with formal mathematical notation.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将使用正式的数学符号详细阐述这一设定。

paragraphs.en: To simplify exposition, in the main text we will leverage the formalism of fully observable Markov decision processes (MDPs). The definitions we provide are generalized in Appendix C to partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs).
paragraphs.zh: 为简化阐述，正文中我们将采用完全可观测马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的形式化方法。 我们给出的定义在附录C中被推广到部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）。

sents.en: To simplify exposition, in the main text we will leverage the formalism of fully observable Markov decision processes (MDPs).
sents.zh: 为简化阐述，正文中我们将采用完全可观测马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的形式化方法。

sents.en: The definitions we provide are generalized in Appendix C to partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs).

The transition kernel specifies, for each a ∈ 𝒜 a\in\mathcal{A} , a transition matrix P a P_{a} . Each element P a ​ s ​ s ′ P_{ass^{\prime}} is the probability of transitioning to s ′ s^{\prime} from s s upon executing action a a .

paragraphs.en: To explain these two sources of uncertainty, let us first discuss them in the context of the transition kernel P ∗ P^{*} . First, the designer may not have full knowledge about P ∗ P^{*} . Following Garrabrant et al. (2016) , we refer to this source as empirical uncertainty . Second, even in the absence of empirical uncertainty, the designer may be uncertain due to insufficient time and effort applied to specifying P ∗ P^{*} . We now explain this second form of uncertainty in more depth.

paragraphs.en: Theoretical papers often characterize performance relative to V + V^{+} , or to similar notions of best-case performance (see Section 5 ). As such, theoretical results that characterize performance relative to best-case value cannot distinguish between beneficial and detrimental outcomes. paragraphs.en: Some previous papers also use V − V^{-} , or similar notions of worst-case value, when characterizing performance (see e.g., Fluri et al. (2025) ; Peng et al. (2018a) ). Rather, the concern is that the agent optimizes an objective that is misspecified or unrelated to human preferences and, as a byproduct, causes a catastrophe. A common analogy is that of humans cutting down a rainforest. Humans are not intending to harm animals in the ecosystem but do so while pursuing other goals. While catastrophic for the animals, it is arguably much better than if humans were intentionally torturing the animals. paragraphs.en: What constitutes the simplest distribution depends on the programming language. While our discussion has focused on Python, one may wonder how far the ideas extend to other languages. We briefly discuss this now.

paragraphs.en: We believe that our argument extends naturally to all commonly used programming languages: if a distribution is sufficiently simple then it will be intuitively catastrophic in Minecraft. Thus, we expect the choice of programming language not to impact our interpretation of orthogonal value.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，我们的论证可以自然地推广到所有常用的编程语言：如果一个分布足够简单，那么它在 Minecraft 中将直观地表现为灾难性的。 因此，我们预计编程语言的选择不会影响我们对正交价值的解释。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, and as explained in Appendix E , there is a formal sense in which the simpler a distribution is, the less it can place mass on complex elements. This holds for all languages. But these formal results are directional and do not rule out languages in which a simple distribution concentrates on specific complex states. Furthermore, what constitutes a complex state is language-dependent. In principle, one can construct programming languages in which the best possible state in Minecraft is the simplest state. In that case, with a natural technical assumption, there is a simple singleton that places all its mass on the best possible state. But we consider such cases pathological.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，正如附录 E 中所解释的，从某种形式意义上讲，一个分布越简单，它就越不可能将质量置于复杂元素上。 这对所有语言都成立。 但这些形式化结果是有方向性的，并不排除某些语言中简单分布集中于特定复杂状态的情况。 此外，什么构成复杂状态是取决于语言的。 原则上，人们可以构造这样的编程语言，其中 Minecraft 中最优可能的状态就是最简单的状态。 在这种情况下，在自然的技术假设下，存在一个简单的单元素分布，将其全部质量置于最优可能的状态上。 但我们认为这类情况是病态的。

paragraphs.en: Goal-misgeneralization: This body of work studies how deployed agents may pursue goals at odds with the goals encoded by the training objective. Di Langosco et al. (2022) provide a semi-formal definition of goal misgeneralization. They say a policy goal-misgeneralizes if its trajectories are better explained as those of a policy with “goal-directedness” instead of a policy without goal-directedness, and it receives low reward according to r ∗ r^{*} . They formally define goal-directedness but do not formally define what counts as “low reward”. Shah et al. (2022) also study goal misgeneralization but do not formally specify any reference value in their study (although in their Monster Gridworld and Cultural Transmission examples, they do show the performance of a random policy for comparison). Abdel Sadek et al. (2025) compare expected reward maximization with a regret minimization method for mitigating goal-misgeneralization. They use regret (relative to an optimal policy) as their performance metric.

paragraphs.en: Previous theoretical works often characterize agent performance relative to the best-case and, sometimes, worst-case value. This paper introduced two alternative reference values, baseline and orthogonal value, in order to define a meaningful notion of catastrophic performance. Unlike best-case value, baseline value provides a way to distinguish between detrimental performance and mere suboptimality. Compared to worst-case value, orthogonal value more accurately reflects the nature and magnitude of the central concern of the alignment community. We believe these new reference values will prove more useful in analyzing catastrophic risk from misaligned AI.
paragraphs.zh: 以往的理论工作通常相对于最优值、有时相对于最差值来刻画智能体的表现。 本文引入了两个替代性的参考值——基线值和正交值，以便定义一个有意义灾难性表现概念。 与最优值不同，基线值提供了一种区分有害表现与单纯次优表现的方法。 相较于最差值，正交值更准确地反映了智能体对齐社区核心关注的性质与规模。 我们相信这些新的参考值在分析智能体错位人工智能带来的灾难性风险时将更有用。

paragraphs.en: We choose this model to match a standard Python or Java interpreter of the following sort. paragraphs.en: So what should the prior represent? Ultimately, we want to enable theoretical analysis of the conditions that give rise to misaligned AI agents producing catastrophic outcomes.
